== English Special Edition comparison ==
The Light-side text protects characters targeted by Undercover from Hutt Smooch. The earlier wording protects Undercover itself. The Dark-side Force-drain text is the same in both sources.

[https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=26 Players Committee, Decipher Errata, June 2017], PDF page 26. [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=106 Players Committee, Advanced Rulebook, 2023, Appendix A], PDF page 106.
